title: search for today says 'No more trains today' right after warning that the legacy shop failed and trains may be missing

evidence.when: today, before 25 Jan 2027, in the evening, while the legacy shop answers 503
evidence.notice: Renfe's legacy shop failed, so this list may be missing trains. No more trains today after 20:00; try --date tomorrow.
evidence.why_wrong: the new system only lists some of the day's trains, so its last one having left proves nothing; a script following the last sentence gives up on trains still to leave
